name: Amagiyugashima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Amagiyugashima town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain range.
history: Flag of the former town of Amagiyugashima in Shizuoka Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-04-01.

features.role: Amagiyugashima town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain range
